applies_to: Belimo JR rotary actuators for butterfly valves in the BACnet MS/TP version (JR..A-BAC-..).
summary: The JR..A-BAC-.. is a Belimo rotary actuator for butterfly valves with BACnet MS/TP on board. The BMS writes a % setpoint to AO 1 and reads position and status; two extra sensor inputs (0-10 V, passive temperature or switch) can be read over the bus. The setpoint can also come from a 0-10 V signal, chosen with SpSource (MV 122).
notes: Sensor objects and the analog setpoint go Out_Of_Service when they do not apply to the selected sensor type or setpoint source.
AV 20 / AV 24 temperatures follow the unit picked in MV 127 (°C, K or °F), so no unit is shown.
State lists keep Belimo's unused positions shown as '-'.
The document marks BI 20 / BI 21 as R / W; kept as writable.

source.title: BACnet Interface Description, JR actuator (rotary actuator for butterfly valves)

integration.summary: Set MV 122 SpSource to Bus and command AO 1 SpRel. Read AI 1 position and MV 99 summary status. The bus watchdog (AV 130, default 120 s) needs AO 1 or MV 1 to be rewritten within the timeout.

minimum_points.name: SpSource
minimum_points.why: Must be Bus for AO 1 to take effect

integration.enable: MV 122 SpSource selects the setpoint: Analog (1, default) follows the 0-10 V signal on wire 3; Bus (2) uses AO 1. MV 1 Override can force Open, Close, Mid or Max.
integration.heartbeat: AV 130 BusWatchdog, 5-3600 s, default 120 s. If neither AO 1 nor MV 1 is rewritten within the timeout the actuator runs the action in MV 130 BusFailAction (default None) and MV 135 shows Bus Watchdog active.
setup: Max 32 nodes without repeater; 120 ohm termination (BV 99 shows its state).
gotchas: Writable objects with instance 90 or above are stored persistently and should not be written cyclically.
Default SpSource is Analog, so AO 1 does nothing until MV 122 is set to Bus.
Max 5 active COV subscriptions, lifetime up to 8 hours.
